boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented University of Arkansas traditions that connect campus history, Razorback athletics, and student milestones.

cards.title: Trace Senior Walk
cards.subtitle: Graduate names engraved across campus
cards.notes: Begin near Old Main and follow the engraved sidewalks across campus. Search for a graduate’s name and year before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide record of University of Arkansas graduates.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Senior Walk contains names of more than 230,000 Arkansas graduates and dates to the first graduating class in 1876.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sidewalks on the University of Arkansas campus; observe posted campus access guidance.

cards.title: Learn the Hog Call
cards.subtitle: “Woo Pig Sooie” Razorback cheer
cards.notes: Listen for the call at a public Razorback event, then join only when the crowd does. Keep the full chant respectful and situational.
cards.short_summary: The Hog Call is Arkansas’s distinctive shared rallying cheer.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Calling the Hogs as a recognizable chant used by Razorback fans in unison after big plays, scores, or to show spirit.
cards.access_notes: Public-event access and ticket requirements vary by sport and venue.

cards.title: Find the campus Razorbacks
cards.subtitle: Wild-hog tributes around Fayetteville campus
cards.notes: Spot a named Razorback tribute on a campus walk, including the Wild Band of Razorbacks monument near Razorback Stadium.
cards.short_summary: Campus monuments and objects repeatedly honor the Razorback identity.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Razorback Reverence as campus tributes to wild hogs, including Il Porcellino on Maple Street and the Wild Band of Razorbacks monument.
cards.access_notes: View outdoor landmarks from public paths and respect any barriers or event operations.

cards.title: Meet Tusk’s tradition
cards.subtitle: Live Razorback mascot appearance
cards.notes: Check official athletics announcements for a public appearance. View from the designated spectator area and follow staff instructions around the animal.
cards.short_summary: Tusk is the live mascot representing the Razorbacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that Tusk VI, a Russian boar, is the live mascot representing the Razorbacks.
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances are event-dependent; do not approach or touch the animal unless staff explicitly permit it.

cards.title: See the class form an “A”
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome rally at Razorback Stadium
cards.notes: If you are an incoming student, use official orientation messages for attendance details; photograph the class formation only from permitted areas.
cards.short_summary: New freshmen gather for a stadium pep rally and class-photo formation.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says incoming freshmen gather at Razorback Stadium near the start of each fall semester for a pep rally and class photo shaped like an “A.”
cards.access_notes: Participation and timing are determined by current new-student programming.

cards.title: Hear Old Main’s 5 p.m. melody
cards.subtitle: Alma Mater from the Old Main bell tower
cards.notes: Pause near Old Main at 5 p.m. to listen for the Alma Mater melody. On the first class day, listen instead for the noon performance.
cards.short_summary: Old Main’s bell tower marks the day with the university song.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that Old Main bell-tower chimes play the Alma Mater melody daily at 5 p.m., and at noon on the first day of classes.
cards.access_notes: Listen from public outdoor campus areas; construction, weather, and campus operations may affect the experience.

cards.title: Visit Spoofer’s Stone
cards.subtitle: Old Main Lawn limestone landmark
cards.notes: Find the limestone stone near Old Main, read its history, and take a photo from the lawn without climbing or leaving objects behind.
cards.short_summary: A leftover Old Main limestone block became a campus courtship landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says students once left love notes in Spoofer’s Stone and that it later became a popular proposal site.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark near Old Main; respect the lawn and any posted restrictions.

cards.title: Watch the Hogs run through the “A”
cards.subtitle: Razorback football pregame entrance
cards.notes: Arrive before kickoff for the pregame show and watch from your ticketed seat as the band forms the giant “A” for the team entrance.
cards.short_summary: The football team’s entrance passes through a giant band-formed “A.”
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Running Through the “A” as a long-standing Razorback football tradition in which the team runs through an “A” formed by the marching band.
cards.access_notes: Requires access to a home football game; confirm kickoff time and ticket policies with Arkansas Athletics.

cards.title: Point to Old Main during the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: University song gesture
cards.notes: At an appropriate university gathering, sing along if you know the first verse and point toward the Towers of Old Main on its final line.
cards.short_summary: The Alma Mater includes a traditional gesture toward Old Main.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arkansas Alumni Association states that it is tradition to point to the Towers of Old Main during the last line of the first verse of the Alma Mater.
cards.access_notes: Take part at public university gatherings when the song is performed; participation is optional.

cards.title: Follow Homecoming Week
cards.subtitle: Parade, Senior Walk dedication, and alumni events
cards.notes: Use the current Homecoming schedule to choose a public event, such as the parade or Senior Walk dedication, and verify route or entry details.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming connects students and alumni through a recurring week of events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arkansas Alumni Association says University of Arkansas Homecoming began in 1922 and includes activities such as Senior Walk Dedication, the Homecoming Parade, and the Alumni Awards Celebration.
cards.access_notes: Dates, locations, admission, and public access vary each year; verify the current university Homecoming schedule.

warnings: Annual and game-day traditions require checking current university or athletics schedules before visiting.
